svg.text: PARTS LIST: ONE GATE SYSTEM (A PAIR OF LEAVES)
Bought in. electric linear actuator, 500 mm stroke, IP68
Stainless steel A4, M24 x 410 resin anchor and nut (bought in)
Bought in. absolute rotary encoder, IP68
Bought in. electro-mechanical linear actuator, 20 kN, 1300 stroke, IP68
Bought in. 1.1 kW motor and gearbox, 230 V
Stainless steel 316 bar, 70 dia, hard chromed
Concrete C40/50, cast in the chamber
Bought in. stainless IP66 enclosure, controller, mains isolator, UPS
Galvanised steel tube, 120 dia, on a base plate
Bought in. PTZ camera with bracket, IP67
Bought in. stop button and intercom, IP66
41 different parts, 120 parts in all. Quantities are for one gate system: a pair of leaves with their hinges, drives and chambers.
ONE LEAF FROM DOWNSTREAM, ITEMS 1 TO 19
1. Items 1 to 8 are welded into one leaf frame (6 mm fillet welds minimum).
2. Bought in items are modelled from the maker's catalogue sizes.
3. Fixed items (20 to 41) are shown on ESP23-GA-01 and GA-03.
4. Each part has its own drawing, ESP23-Pnn (nn = item), and its own
STEP file and Inventor build steps on the ESP 2023 project page.
Third angle projection. Drawn from the CAD model with hidden line removal.
